code:
Azure: Defender for Servers
  -> Defender for Endpoint (EDR)
  -> vulnerability assessment

AWS: GuardDuty Malware Protection for EC2
  -> agentless EBS scan, triggered on suspicion
AWS: Inspector
  -> ongoing OS/package vulnerability scanning
caption: AWS assembles VM protection from services; Azure ships it as one Defender plan.

code:
Build time (image scan):
  Defender for Containers -> ACR images
  Amazon Inspector -> ECR images

Runtime (while executing):
  Defender for Containers -> AKS sensor
  GuardDuty EKS Protection + Runtime Monitoring
caption: A clean image scan says nothing about what that container does once it's running.
